overview: REC vs RE, closure, complement, Turing machine problems (halting, emptiness), reductions.
coreConcept: Recursive => decidable; RE => semi-decidable. L aur L^c dono RE ho to L recursive.
hinglishExplanation: Agar L recursive hai to complement bhi recursive. RE languages complement ke under closed nahi hain. Reductions me undecidability aage propagate hoti hai: A <= B aur B decidable to A decidable.
formalDefinition: Recursive => decidable; RE => semi-decidable. L aur L^c dono RE ho to L recursive.
importantProperties: Recursive closed under complement, union, intersection.
RE closed under union, intersection, not under complement.
L and L^c both RE => L recursive.
Rice theorem: nontrivial semantic properties undecidable.
Mapping reduction A<=B: B decidable => A decidable.
